title_text: The free bifibration on a functor

Inline.Text: We consider the problem of constructing the free bifibration generated by a functor of categories

. This problem was previously considered by Lamarche, and is closely related to the problem, considered by Dawson, Paré, and Pronk, of “freely adjoining adjoints” to a category. We develop a proof-theoretic approach to the problem, beginning with a construction of the free bifibration
